text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 268, October 29, 1970 ]
ESTABLISHING A PRESIDENTIAL AWARD IN EDUCATION
WHEREAS, 1970 has been declared as International Education Year by the United Nations General
Assembly to focus attention of member states on the important role of education in the development of human
resources essential to the attainment of the goals of the Second U.N. Development Decade;
WHEREAS, the value of education in promoting the country’s enlightenment and progress, as well as world
peace and understanding, is universally recognized; and
WHEREAS, it is but proper that due recognition be given to those who have helped advance education in this
country particularly at this time of our observance of International Education Year;
NOW, THEREFORE I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby establish a PRESIDENTIAL AWARD IN EDUCATION which shall be
granted this year, and every three years thereafter, to those who have made significant and distinctive
contributions in the field of education in this country.
A Committee on the Presidential Award in Education is hereby created to plan and implement a system of
giving the awards, including selection procedures, funding and other details, composed of the following:
The incumbent Secretary of Education, as Chairman, and a former secretary of Education and an outstanding
citizen, to be designated by the President as members.
This order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ROBERTO V. REYES
Acting Executive Secretary
